title: Network segmentation, API perimeter and zero-trust controls
workflow: Inventory inbound, east-west and outbound service dependencies
Assign trust zones and service identities by business domain
Protect accounting, KMS, privileged admin and external rail paths
Log connection decisions without leaking payloads
Test deny-by-default and review exceptions for emergency channels
invariants: Public gateway cannot directly access core accounting database
Rail adapter requires approved signed protocol and participant network rules
Administrative access uses controlled bastion/PAM with trace
Environment trust roots are not shared blindly
Network policy changes require approved documented impact
approval_gate: CISO network topology acceptance, institution-hosting policy and executed isolation/penetration testing.
